name: Woodwarped

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Its Splintered Propagation copy is described in the reaction; the notes file lists it as a code need.

traits.name: Axe Vulnerability
traits.summary: Takes extra damage (Vulnerability) from Slashing damage by a battleaxe, greataxe or handaxe.
traits.text: Slashing damage dealt by a Battleaxe, a Greataxe or a Handaxe is doubled against the woodwarped. Other Slashing damage is not.

traits.name: Frightened Immunity (Axes Excepted)
traits.summary: Immune to Frightened, except from creatures holding an axe.
traits.text: The woodwarped can't be Frightened, unless the creature frightening it is holding an axe.

traits.name: Aversion to Axes
traits.summary: At its turn's start, if it sees a creature holding a battleaxe, greataxe or handaxe, it is Frightened until its next turn begins.
traits.text: When the woodwarped's turn begins and it can see a creature holding a Battleaxe, a Greataxe or a Handaxe, it has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Thorns
traits.summary: At the start of its turns, creatures it grapples or that grapple it take 2d4 Piercing.
traits.text: At the start of each of its turns the woodwarped deals 5 (2d4) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling and to any creature grappling it.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: +6, 1d6+4 Slashing plus 1d8 Poison; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14), one hold per claw.
actions.text: Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing plus 4 (1d8) Poison damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of its two claws.

actions.name: Thorn Spray
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. 15-ft emanation, DC 13 Dex save (Disadvantage if grappled by it): 4d6 Piercing and Poisoned (save again each turn end; ends after a minute); half damage on a success.
actions.text: Dexterity save, DC 13, for each creature within 15 feet, with Disadvantage if the woodwarped has it Grappled. Failure: 14 (4d6) Piercing damage and the target is Poisoned; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, and after a minute it succeeds on its own. Success: half damage only.

reactions.name: Splintered Propagation
reactions.trigger: It takes Slashing damage that isn't from a battleaxe, greataxe or handaxe.
reactions.summary: Once a day, when hit by non-axe Slashing damage, a Small copy with 10 Hit Points and only the Claw action grows in a free space within 5 ft and acts on the original's Initiative.
reactions.text: A fragment breaks off and quickly grows into a new woodwarped in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The new one is Small, has 10 Hit Points, has only the Claw action and no Splintered Propagation, and takes its turn on the original's Initiative.

summary: A wooden mimic of a victim's body grown from root and vine; it grapples and sprays thorns, grows a new copy from non-axe cuts, and fears axes.
